about: Coverage board (scripts/coverage-plan.py from coverage.json): layouts, frames (setup x variant), sequence. DRAFTED.

cov-game-SCREEN-face.action: The arena: the glowing hologram play floor with its walls and gliders, the crowded tiers rising around it, and above the floor one huge screen showing {D}'s calm face in close-up.

cov-game-PIT-D-playing.action: {D} in his sunken pit at the glowing console, playing: eyes on the board, hands still, patient, unhurried.

cov-game-PIT-D-glasses.action: {D} in his sunken pit lifts the cabled glasses off his face with one hand, the other hand empty on the console; a small private closed-mouth smile.

cov-overlook-MASTER-watch.action: At the overlook railing, seen from out over the hall: {Z} on the left leans on the railing watching the game far below, admiring; {B} on the right is bent over the small gadget she is working on, not looking up.

cov-overlook-MASTER-lean.action: At the overlook railing: {B} on the right has set her gadget on the rail and leans out over the railing studying the board below; {Z} on the left watches the game.

cov-overlook-OTS-Z-dry.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: {B}, the gadget in her hands, glances at him, dry, unimpressed.
cov-overlook-OTS-Z-dry.subject: B

cov-overlook-OTS-Z-shrug.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: {B} snaps the gadget's casing shut and shrugs, looking up at him.
cov-overlook-OTS-Z-shrug.subject: B

cov-overlook-OTS-Z-wry.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: {B} glances sideways at him, wry, a small closed-mouth smile.
cov-overlook-OTS-Z-wry.subject: B

cov-overlook-CU-B-toast.action: {B} close, leaning over the railing, face lit from below by the holograms, eyes narrowed, studying the pieces, serious. Any big screens in the background show only glowing abstract game graphics, never a face.
cov-overlook-CU-B-toast.subject: B

cov-corridor-MASTER-arrive.action: The elevator doors stand open; {D} on the right steps out of the elevator, easy and friendly; {Z} on the left, standing, eager, half a step toward him; {B} behind {Z}, arms crossed, bored.

cov-corridor-OTS-Z-easy.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: {D} in the elevator doorway, easy and friendly, talking.
cov-corridor-OTS-Z-easy.subject: D

cov-corridor-OTS-Z-warm.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: {D} in the elevator doorway, open and warm, asking.
cov-corridor-OTS-Z-warm.subject: D

cov-corridor-OTS-D-eager.action: Over {D}'s shoulder: {Z}, standing, eager; behind him {B} stands with her arms crossed, bored.
cov-corridor-OTS-D-eager.subject: Z

cov-corridor-CU-B-sour.action: {B} close, a shrug and a sour twist of her mouth, arms crossed.
cov-corridor-CU-B-sour.subject: B

cov-walk-CU-Z-tease.action: {Z} walking, close, turned three-quarters toward her on the right of the frame, teasing, a closed-mouth smile.
cov-walk-CU-Z-tease.subject: Z

cov-walk-CU-Z-hopeful.action: {Z} walking, close, turned toward her, hopeful, a closed-mouth smile.
cov-walk-CU-Z-hopeful.subject: Z

cov-walk-CU-B-serious.action: {B} walking, close, eyes ahead, serious and worried about him, not smiling.
cov-walk-CU-B-serious.subject: B

cov-walk-CU-B-sly.action: {B} walking, close, a sly closed-mouth smile, glancing toward him on the left of the frame.
cov-walk-CU-B-sly.subject: B

cov-cafe-MASTER-wave.action: At the long rectangular table: {D} on the right turns and raises one hand to wave someone over, a soft closed-mouth laugh; {B} across from him looks over too; the chair at the left end is empty.

cov-cafe-OTS-Z-talk.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: {D} at the long table, talking, easy and warm.
cov-cafe-OTS-Z-talk.subject: D

cov-cafe-OTS-Z-menu.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: {D} at the long table, a thin glowing menu in hand, modest.
cov-cafe-OTS-Z-menu.subject: D

cov-cafe-OTS-Z-stern.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: {D}, a mock-stern face with a playful closed-mouth smile: a joking lecture.
cov-cafe-OTS-Z-stern.subject: D

cov-cafe-OTS-Z-eager.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: {D} leans in, eager and inviting, smiling with his mouth closed.
cov-cafe-OTS-Z-eager.subject: D

cov-cafe-CU-Z-amused.action: {Z} close, amused, a closed-mouth smile, looking toward the right of the frame at Deluin.
cov-cafe-CU-Z-amused.subject: Z

cov-cafe-CU-Z-smile.action: {Z} close, a little embarrassed, smiling with his mouth closed, looking toward the right of the frame at Deluin.
cov-cafe-CU-Z-smile.subject: Z

cov-cafe-CU-D-warm.action: {D} close, warm, thinking about home, looking toward the left of the frame at Zei.
cov-cafe-CU-D-warm.subject: D

cov-cafe-CU-B-menu.action: {B} close, glancing down at her thin glowing menu, unimpressed.
cov-cafe-CU-B-menu.subject: B

cov-cafe-CU-B-standing.action: {B}, standing now, big headphones in her hand, looking down toward the left of the frame at Zei: serious, a straight face, not smiling.
cov-cafe-CU-B-standing.subject: B

cov-cafe-BAI-sideeye.action: {B} at her small round table, big headphones on, a handheld in her hands, glancing sideways out of the corner of her eye toward the left of the frame.
cov-cafe-BAI-sideeye.subject: B

cov-cafe-BAI-what.action: {B} at her small round table turns in her chair toward the left of the frame and lifts one side of her big headphones off one ear, loudly.
cov-cafe-BAI-what.subject: B

cov-cafe-SUGAR-stack.action: Very close at table height: {D}'s fingers, his cream cable-knit sleeve showing, absent-mindedly setting one small white sugar cube on another between two tea cups.

cov-cafe-SUGAR-wall.action: Very close at table height: a neat little wall of small white sugar cubes, two rows high, between two tea cups on the wooden table.

cov-cafe-SUGAR-flick.action: Very close at table height: a finger flicks one small white sugar cube out of the bottom row of the little wall between two tea cups; the cube flies.

cov-cafe-SUGAR-door.action: Very close at table height: the little wall of small white sugar cubes between two tea cups, now with one cube missing from the middle of the bottom row: a doorway.

cov-cafe-CU-Z0-whoa.action: {Z} close at the end of the table, eyes on the thin glowing menu in his hands, surprised.
cov-cafe-CU-Z0-whoa.subject: Z

cov-cafe-CU-Z0-listen.action: {Z} close at the end of the table, looking up toward the right of the frame, a little surprised, a thin glowing menu in his hands.
cov-cafe-CU-Z0-listen.subject: Z

cov-cafe-CU-Z0-explain.action: {Z} close, the thin glowing menu in his hands, explaining, keen, looking toward the right of the frame at Deluin.
cov-cafe-CU-Z0-explain.subject: Z

cov-cafe-CU-Z0-astonished.action: {Z} close, astonished, looking toward the right of the frame at Deluin.
cov-cafe-CU-Z0-astonished.subject: Z

cov-gate-MASTER-fingers.action: At the courtyard's street gate at dusk, the lamps coming on: {D} on the right holds up one open hand, five fingers spread wide; {Z} on the left holds up his open hand the same way, a closed-mouth smile. Both hands clearly drawn.

cov-gate-MASTER-wave.action: At the street gate at dusk: {D} on the right, turning to go into the street, gives a quick wave goodbye; {Z} on the left waves back.

cov-gate-CU-Z-smile.action: {Z} close at the gate at dusk, a closed-mouth smile, looking toward the right of the frame at Deluin.
cov-gate-CU-Z-smile.subject: Z

cov-dusk-MASTER-talk.action: At dusk in the emptying courtyard: {Z} on the left stands at {B}'s small round table and talks to her; {B} on the right, seated, headphones around her neck, looks up at him.

cov-lobby-CU-Z-down.action: {Z}'s face close, eyes looking down at the device in his hands as it lights up; worried, not smiling.
cov-lobby-CU-Z-down.subject: Z

cov-lobby-CU-Z-relief.action: {Z} close, eyes closing, breathing out in relief, his device in his hands.
cov-lobby-CU-Z-relief.subject: Z

cov-lobby-MASTER-sits.action: The hotel lobby restaurant late at night: {Z} on the left at his table, worried, not smiling; {B} on the right sits down across from him carefully, concerned and caring, without a word.

cov-lobby-OTS-Z-turns.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: he turns his glowing device to show {B}; {B} across the table leans in to read it, her face unreadable.
cov-lobby-OTS-Z-turns.subject: B
